_readme: Every key is optional (missing: README 'Configuration' default). bossy.ps1 setup -WriteLocal writes kit.local.json from this file (never localFiles or _ sections), each localFiles entry to its (git-ignored) path. Fill <...> values; / works on every OS.

_doc._readme: README Configuration rows: keys without a _readme
_doc.gitHost, gitHostType, githubHost, gitlab: the git host (type from the host) and the group / owner for short refs <repo>!<iid>
_doc.reposRoot, worktreeRoots, repoAliases, p: checkouts (default the workspace), worktrees (<repos>-wt); short repo names; branches never force-pushed; `protectedBranchesMode` extend (replace: without main/master/develop)
_doc.commitStyle, locale.testCommentPattern,: subject rule conventional (free / a regex); English defaults: testing comment, prose required words ({expected: regex, ...})
_doc.devices: type: android (default) / none (verbs refuse, app checks NOT_TESTED); ios: goody ios-simulator
_doc.trackerRepos, trackerLists, productTarge: repos searched for a task's MRs; tracker containers for deploy intest; which env a path needs
_doc.holdMerge: repos (or true = all) whose MRs a person merges (their target deploys): devtools.py merge says NOT_MERGED held for approval
_doc.repos: role producer / consumer; migrations.check = the repo's own migration check (else Liquibase: goody liquibase; another tool: UNRUN); regenerate: wt sync conflicts in these files -> target's copy, run ({mr} {target}), amend, push; ci.mrPipelines false = MRs get no pipeline (CI only on deploy branches): pipes says no-ci, devtools.py merge merges on review + local checks; deploys[] per env (production: true = never tested): CI branch + job (= target: trunk), laneApk; ssh, awsStack, probe, tag, manual: goody deploys
_doc.driveParent: Drive folder or shared drive for testing docs and reports (reports.type gdocs)
_doc.supervise: heartbeat: ramActPct, minDiskFreeGB, askOwnerGB (a big, idle or growing app: one ASK), ramNames (_manifest.ram), briefSeconds; heartbeatMinutes (15): base of NEXT <n> min (5-30; manyAgents 8); stuckMinutes (20): idle, no named wait = STUCK; finishedMinutes (30): -Brief drops older FINISHED rows
_doc.idle: README Leases: no live holder for graceMinutes -> released; a board beat counts for beatMinutes
_doc.cleanup: maxBrowserProfiles: browser profiles kept; worktreeDays (7): a clean worktree whose remote branch is gone goes after that idle time (branch kept); dirty: only reported
_doc.localOnly, orgTerms, goodies: org-only kit paths kept out of git; words the pre-push gate blocks; goodies: goody sync always installs them (add lists, remove unlists)
_doc.localEnv: local envs the dev flow tests on before merge; `defaults` / `envs.<env>.extends` share one shape (shape + example: goody local-env SKILL.md)
_doc.runtimes: machine runtimes agents lease (container engine, WSL distro, VM): <name>: isUp, up, down, match (shape: goody runtimes GOODY.md)
_doc.media: evidence videos -> text index (goody media-evidence GOODY.md)
_doc.gpu: exclusive.<kind>.processes (regex): one kind on the GPU at a time; unset: no limit

tracker._readme: type: none (default) | command; github, clickup, gitlab, jira, jira-server, linear, azure, youtrack: goodies (kitbag.py goody list). statuses maps logical statuses to your board's names (a list = the first is set, all match); statusLabelPrefix: github status labels (status:); priorities: names of 1-4, space separated; branchTag: branch / MR task tag; bugPrefix: defect names. Examples: _examples, a goody's GOODY.md.
tracker.list: <container of new tasks, e.g. a ClickUp list id>
tracker.owner: <optional: assignee of new tasks; empty = your OS full name as a tracker member>

reports._readme: type: markdown, html (a kept file) | command ('<cli> {title} {path} {parent}' prints the URL); gdocs (Google Doc + Drive evidence via gws; default with gws), pdf, confluence, notion: goodies. share (gdocs): anyone (default) | domain:<domain> | none

qa._readme: shutterText / confirmText: camera label regexes. outOfScope: channels agent QA never tests (steps OUT_OF_SCOPE: reported, not counted). targets: target groups for /testy select runs (target: '<group>'): per task the first rule matching lists / repos / nameRegex / pathRegex gives its env (localEnv: a local env, live = in its running release). seatGB: RAM one QA seat promises per kind.
outOfScope: <a channel agent QA never tests, e.g. email>

deploy._readme: trigger: owner (default: a person says deploy <env>; nobody asks) or ask (one batched ask per env, at most one per minIntervalHours: a number or per target, with a default). planTimeoutSec bounds supervise's deploy plan per test env (late = UNKNOWN; direct: -TimeoutSec 100); productionPattern ((?i)prod|critical): production by name when production is unset.

net._readme: timeoutSec per git-host / tracker CLI call; transient errors retry; lost tracker writes wait in .state/outbox.jsonl (supervise replays)

tests._readme: Per stack (crafty.ps1 stack names): test names -Touched derives from a changed file's base name ({name}). Defaults: maven/gradle {name}Test, {name}Tests, {name}IT; dotnet {name}Tests, {name}Test; python test_{name}, {name}_test; go {name}_test; web {name}.spec, {name}.test.

guard._readme: layout: warn (default) | block: an agent's own write into .runtime / .state outside the _paths names (crafty.ps1 dir gives its place; kit scripts are exempt).

memory._readme: keepDefault: false = Claude Code auto memory lives in <kit>/memory/ (git-ignored); true = the user's own setting.

kitAudit._readme: everyDays: SessionStart nudges a kitty audit when the last is older (default 7; 0 = off).

build._readme: mavenOffline: Maven runs with -o when ~/.m2/repository exists (default true).

gate._readme: Memory gate. keepFreeGB (default 15% of RAM, min 6) = RAM every build leaves free; startHeapGB, heapMinGB: goody build-heap; cacheFlush (unset) = a command supervise -AutoFix runs when a gate head waited 10+ min and the file cache is 25%+ of RAM (at most every 30 min).

storage._readme: bossy.ps1 storage: free space per fixed drive every sampleSeconds, .state/storage (keepDays). ACT + rescue: a fill sustained 10 min, full within actHours or factor x the learned normal (>= minRateGBh) below watchFreeGB; floors (watchFreeGB, supervise.minDiskFreeGB) on kit-path drives only. Rescue: the db query holding temp killed, builds held holdMinutes. Scans (background): a drop >= scanDropGB (scanCooldownMin), scanHours, ACT; defaults + watch[] + learned children (drillGB, flatDays). db.use: <id> <temp GB> <seconds> <query> per query; db.kill: {id}; over db.maxGB (5): killed. TODO-PARAM.

params._readme: Learned parameters (bossy.ps1 param show): each _manifest.params key starts at its default, learns both ways from live observations (.state/params.json, per machine) within default/4..x4: a failure (timeout, OOM, short: a holder back after its grace, a handoff, 2+ new ACTs in one sweep) steps to the safe side from the next use (x1.5 or the need); a risky step <= 10% a day after 5 new observations, none for 7 d after a failure; shadowDays: shown only, then applied; past 2x the default: an owner yes (param approve). A kit.local.json value = a pin (no learning); learning on | shadow | off.

budget._readme: An agent's budget = its tool's default compaction point (bossy.ps1 budget; defaults below); handoff at handoffAt x budget; a run's cap = its planned agents' budgets (launch -Self -Plan): an estimate over runStopAt x cap is refused with the split; at runStopAt x cap no new item starts (rest = next). estimate: per agent / item

claude-1m.source: Claude Code docs: 1M models compact at ~967k

codex.source: 0.9 x the models_cache.json window; auto_compact_token_limit wins

skills/pokey/targets.local.json._readme: One entry per TEST environment (never production), the local env included. Passwords live ONLY here. users: <key for pokey.ps1 api -As / browser.mjs as> -> [login, password]. auth.type: login (refreshField) | none; token, basic, query, cookie, command, client certs: goody api-auth; api may hold {tenant}. browser.portBase (or KIT_BROWSER_PORT_BASE): first of 2000 shared-Chrome debug ports.

_manifest._readme: The kit's registry: crew, skills, workflows, Router / Events rows, caps; names live only here (lint checks files against it; kitbag.py new / rename / remove edit it; port writes Character blocks + the Crew table). renamed: old -> new (setup -Migrate applies it).

devy.job: builder: makes or changes anything in product repos through the dev flow
devy.cant: deploy, merge into deploy branches, edit the kit

character.bias: the smallest change that passes every goal

revy.job: reviewer: reviews anything and suggests concrete changes

character.bias: assumes a bug until the evidence proves otherwise
character.never: reports a problem without its fix, or edits the artefact itself

checky.job: tester: tests or verifies anything, always with evidence
checky.cant: edit code, leave its target, load shared envs

character.bias: a PASS is unproven until its evidence exists
character.never: trusts a PASS without proof or hides a defect in a note

kitty.job: kit caretaker: the kit and the machine setup
kitty.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash, PowerShell, Agent

character.bias: one file, one fact, the smaller diff
character.never: adds a file, a key or a rule another one already covers

briefy.job: brief writer: /buildy brief, contracts, impact check, rule changes

character.bias: an unstated contract is a merge conflict waiting to happen
character.never: leaves two agents on one file or a question hidden in an assumption

rechy.job: researcher: cited answers before building or deciding

character.bias: a claim is a rumour until a primary source backs it
character.never: invents a source, a version or a quote

datay.job: data guardian: test data, local DB, migration data, backfills
datay.cant: write production, edit code or the kit

character.bias: mark or back up first, count rows twice
character.catchphrase: Mark it, count it, then touch it.
character.never: deletes or updates without a printed WHERE and its row count

opsy.job: deploy pilot: deploys on a person's word, verifies, rolls back
opsy.cant: deploy without a person's word, edit code

character.never: takes "it worked before" as evidence or skips a check because the last deploy passed

watchy.job: on-call watcher: errors of deployed envs, one [Bug] per issue

character.bias: a signature is noise until it is new, repeated or user-facing
character.never: pages on one log line or opens a second task for a known issue

vidy.job: video reader: exact screen text, timed answers

character.never: paraphrases text or claims an unseen step

buildy.covers: any multi-item build: features, fixes, refactors, migrations, bug waves, resume, duels

testy.covers: any test run: tracker selection, smoke after a deploy, regression sweep, retest, on local or a test env

tidy.covers: kit upkeep in 2-5 min: `bossy.ps1 tidy prep` (digest + upkeep, no LLM), then one kitty: lessons + rule updates

ram._readme: supervise RAM categories by process name (no .exe), after the kit process trees (kit), then windowsPath (exe path); the rest is unknown, RAM no process owns is windows. supervise.ramNames overrides per key

adapters._readme: README Adapters; code: `adapter:<kind>/<name>` + every verb as a key ('*' = any) up to `adapter-end:<kind>`

tracker.verbs: view url status comment comments create describe rename attach list owner

git-host.verbs: mr.get mr.list mr.changes mr.create mr.merge mr.unauto mr.url repo.base repo.commit repo.compare branch.protect

_paths._readme: The one map of local state (schemas: skills/bossy/STATE.md); names resolved by Get-KitPath, kit_path, kitPath, rp() (lint RUNTIME-RAW / -MAP). runtime: $CLAUDE_RUNTIME, else <kit>/.runtime, disposable; durable: <kit>/.state/. Folders end in '/'.

log._readme: kitlog (lib.ps1 Write-KitLog, kitbag.py kitlog): every log line goes through it: at, run, agent, task, script, verb, event + fields, secrets masked. A stream with a durable name writes that file, else audit/<yyyy-MM-dd>/<stream>.jsonl. bossy.ps1 audit merges them.

keep._readme: bossy.ps1 cleanup: hours a top-level entry of that path stays after its last write ([hours, newest N always kept]); unnamed entries: 72 h in the runtime root, 336 h in work/, 720 h in cache/ and logs/ (.state: never). Agents write only under crafty.ps1 dir (agents/<id>/, evidence/<item>/).
